source_of_truth: live GitHub evidence plus per-repository governing documents

scheduler.project_fairness_rule: after one bounded repair attempt on the highest-priority blocked lane, service other unblocked independent projects in the same run
scheduler.orchestrator_starvation_guard: orchestrator maintenance must not consume the only substantive implementation slot while executable P0-P5 product work exists

compatibility_planning.rule: identify direct and transitive consumers before shared-contract changes; prepare dependents first for breaking changes and never knowingly leave the Knowledge Engine family broken

learning_memory.persist_rule: verified, sanitized lessons only; never persist secrets, credentials, raw private Product Reality payloads, or unverified conclusions

tooling_leverage.rule: adopt free maintainable tools only when they close an observed feedback-loop gap; prefer official implementations, least privilege, local/advisory introduction before material CI cost, and never report availability before verification

n8n_orchestration.scheduler: none; DoWork remains the single portfolio scheduler

permanently_unknown_metrics.blocked_waiting_seconds: GitHub exposes only current mergeable_state, not a historical blocked timeline
permanently_unknown_metrics.preflight_failures_prevented_count: local preflight runs leave no committed, API-accessible trace
permanently_unknown_metrics.product_reality_debt_created_count: Product Reality is human validation, not CI-inferable
permanently_unknown_metrics.product_reality_debt_resolved_count: Product Reality is human validation, not CI-inferable
permanently_unknown_metrics.autonomous_intervention_count: no deterministic GitHub signal distinguishes autonomous vs. required intervention
permanently_unknown_metrics.jeremy_required_intervention_count: no deterministic GitHub signal distinguishes autonomous vs. required intervention

automatic_evidence_collector.idempotency: incremental via prior window_end per (project, repository), plus explicit evidence_ref dedup independent of --since
forbidden: ingesting raw webhook payloads, signatures, tokens, or credentials
fabricating a measurement for a metric with no reliable source
granting the reinvestment controller execution or merge authority

deterministic_repair_engine.execution_boundary: local working tree only; engine does not commit, push, open PRs, merge, weaken checks, or alter Product Reality evidence
deterministic_repair_engine.regression_rule: recurring verified failure fingerprints should be promoted into earlier repository-native prevention when practical

parallel_specialist_lanes.stale_rule: default-branch head change invalidates lane until revalidated
parallel_specialist_lanes.knowledge_engine_rule: one coordinated parent lane with Core/Web/AI sublanes; shared-contract changes require compatibility clearance

predictive_work_decomposition.task_source: explicit authoritative roadmap/design candidate slices only
predictive_work_decomposition.score_semantics: ordinal structural priority only; never duration/ROI/probability/readiness percent
predictive_work_decomposition.output: conflict-aware dependency waves for specialist-lane reservation

automatic_regression_prevention.action: recommend earlier repository-native prevention; actual product-repo change remains normal engineering work with preflight/CI

portfolio_throughput_optimizer.eligibility_rule: rank only projects already eligible after P0-P4, product authority, dependency, ownership, and Product Reality gates
portfolio_throughput_optimizer.unknown_policy: UNKNOWN and INSUFFICIENT_DATA are omitted and never coerced to zero
portfolio_throughput_optimizer.score_semantics: ordinal measured bottleneck severity only; never predicted gain/ROI/probability/capacity percentage/readiness percent
